summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat away at Foley Meir in their opening fixture, with Saul Shotton grabbing a late consolation goal but the team ultimately unable to capitalize on their chances throughout the match. Despite the disappointing loss, the squad will look to bounce back this weekend at home against Stafford Town, a promotion contender, as they aim to make a strong atmosphere at the ground and secure their first points of the season.
